MATCH (c)-[:MEMBER_OF]->(x) WHERE x.name CONTAINS '潮汐' RETURN c.name AS member LIMIT 15

MATCH (a {name:'乌桑'})-[r:TEACHER_OF]-(b) RETURN type(r), b.name AS other LIMIT 8
MATCH (c)-[:MASTERS]->(m) RETURN c.name AS who, m.name AS skill LIMIT 12
